layers.authority: Khánh Hòa Provincial People's Council (Resolution 02/2025/NQ-HĐND, in force from 25 August 2025, replacing 24/2016/NQ-HĐND)
layers.process: Visitors who travel by inland waterway vessel to the sea areas and islands inside the Nha Trang Bay scenic area (outside the strictly protected zone) pay a sightseeing fee per trip. As summarised by a legal database, the Hòn Mun island route is 10,000 dong per person per trip and the combined multi-stop route is 40,000 dong; Khánh Hòa residents, crew and guides working on the islands, and people from some Programme 135 communes are exempt. These amounts come from a secondary summary of the resolution, not its text, so confirm them with the boat operator or the provincial portal. The operator usually collects the fee; ask whether it is already in the boat ticket.
